0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000010_WUKLAMAT
0.description: Savoring the moment? I can feel your excitement...your eagerness to explore the unknown!

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000020_ALISAIE
1.description: Well, for once the fate of the world doesn't rest on our shoulders. We might even get a chance to enjoy ourselves!

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000030_ERENVILLE
2.description: Do not be so quick to relax.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000040_ERENVILLE
3.description: Though Tural may seem but a short sail away on a map, the vast seas between brim with peril. The treacherous waters of Shades' Triangle alone have claimed countless vessels.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000050_ERENVILLE
4.description: Even following the “safe” route plotted by Admiral Bloefhiswyn herself, this will be no pleasure cruise.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000060_WUKLAMAT
5.description: Perhaps, but my voyage here was uneventful enough. Disappointingly so!

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000070_KRILE
6.description: Either way, the two of you have firsthand experience!

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000080_KRILE
7.description: Which will be of great comfort in the days ahead, I'm sure.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000110_ERENVILLE
10.description: It's time. I trust you have everything you need.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000120_ERENVILLE
11.description: And so does our ship cast off from the docks.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000130_ERENVILLE
12.description: We sail west, as Ketenramm did some eighty years past, bound for the “New World”─known to her children as the continent of Tural.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000140_WUKLAMAT
13.description: Just wait, Papa! When this contest is said and done, it'll be your daughter who sits the throne... Me, Wuk Lamat!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000170_SAILORSUNBURNED
16.description: But this sea, she's a fickle one. Calm one moment, blowin' a gale the next.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000180_ERENVILLE
17.description: I'll take my rest while I can, then.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000190_KRILE
18.description: We left port what seems an age ago now, and we've seen naught but open water ahead. I knew Tural was far, but it's another thing to really know.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000200_KRILE
19.description: Speaking of which, some of our fellow passengers have made this trip before─several times in fact. I was able to learn a few things about Tuliyollal and the rite of succession.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000210_KRILE
20.description: Since we still have a long way to go─why not have a chat with them yourself? I'm sure you have questions of your own.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000220_KRILE
21.description: Did you look out across these same waters, Grandfather...?

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000230_ALISAIE
22.description: We're in for a proper storm, it seems.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000240_WUKLAMAT
23.description: [PANTING EXERT, FOLLOWED BY SUDDEN SURGE OF NAUSEA - “Ulp!”]

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000260_WUKLAMAT
25.description: I don't know...what you mean. I don't get seasick.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000270_WUKLAMAT
26.description: I'm just feeling...a little nauseous, is all...

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000290_ALPHINAUD
28.description: Erenville, you were born in Tural, yes? Do many Viera live there?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000300_ERENVILLE
29.description: The Shetona, as my people are called, have settlements mainly in the north, in Xak Tural.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000320_ERENVILLE
31.description: I know nothing of my father─not even his name.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000390_SAILORPANICVOICEA
38.description: (-Alarmed Sailor-)We're in the teeth of it now, lads! Reef that sail afore the mast snaps!

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000410_SAILORPANICVOICEB
40.description: (-Distressed Sailor-)Who the hells was on watch!? This wind's too strong to take in the sai─aaargh!

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000420_SAILORPANICVOICEC
41.description: (-Panicked Sailor-)Man fallen off the mast! We need help!

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000450_ALPHINAUD
44.description: Come, we should lend what aid we can.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000460_ERENVILLE
45.description: I have not seen the ocean rage with such fury before or since.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000470_ERENVILLE
46.description: The heaving waves tossed our ship about like a toy, sending sailors tumbling...

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000480_ERENVILLE
47.description: The dauntless Alisaie, quick to the rescue, was almost lost to the sea herself.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000490_ERENVILLE
48.description: Meanwhile, our champion rushed to deploy the vessel's magical defenses, and thereby shield us from the lightning.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000500_ERENVILLE
49.description: What an extraordinary life <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> must lead to be able to operate such a device with practiced ease.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000510_ERENVILLE
50.description: Wuk Lamat, too, threw herself into the rescue efforts, though one might have mistaken her for another soul in distress.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000520_ERENVILLE
51.description: By the time the unruly seas had calmed, our strength was all but spent, and we had yet to even glimpse the shores of Tural.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000530_ERENVILLE
52.description: In retrospect, of course, that battle against the storm would prove a fitting prelude to the coming contest for the throne.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000540_WUKLAMAT
53.description: Morning. Joining us for some fresh air?

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000550_WUKLAMAT
54.description: Seems my belly has settled along with the weather, but I'll feel much better once we're on solid ground.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000560_WUKLAMAT
55.description: Ugh, can't be much farther now...can it?

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000580_ERENVILLE
57.description: Land must be near. You need only hold out a while longer.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000590_ALISAIE
58.description: For a dark moment, I thought the ocean might swallow us. Glad to have my pessimism proven wrong.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000600_ALPHINAUD
59.description: In other good news, I examined the sailor who took a fall, and he's faring well. I'm sure he'll make a full recovery.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000610_ERENVILLE
60.description: Good news indeed. If all's well, then we needn't delay in launching the landing boat.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000620_ERENVILLE
61.description: Ships have to lower anchor some way from shore. Too close, and they risk having their underbellies ripped open by the reefs that crowd Tuliyollal's coasts. Come.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000630_WUKLAMAT
62.description: Thanks for bringing us all this way!

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000640_SAILORSUNBURNED
63.description: Hah, we only did what we were paid to do! Couldn't hardly set ye adrift halfway!

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000650_SAILORSUNBURNED
64.description: If anythin', it should be us thankin' you for helpin' us through that beast of a storm!

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000660_SAILORSUNBURNED
65.description: As a matter o' fact, everyone's startin' to fancy yer chances in the contest. At this rate, we won't be able to lay wagers no more!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000670_WUKLAMAT
66.description: Then I'd better not let you down!

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000690_ERENVILLE
68.description: We're the last to board. If there's nothing left to say, then let's shove off, shall we?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000700_ALPHINAUD
69.description: Ahh! Blue seas, clear skies, and boundless possibilities... I daresay our destination will soon be in sight.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000720_ALPHINAUD
71.description: There, look my friends! Behold the scene of our next great adventure!

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000730_WUKLAMAT
72.description: At last, we are come to the land you call the “New World.” To my home, Tural!

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000740_ALISAIE
73.description: Gods... I've seen cities with an impressive mix of cultures, but this is something else!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000750_ALPHINAUD
74.description: Is that a...? No. I've never seen Vanu feathers in that color before.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000760_WUKLAMAT
75.description: You'll find much here you never knew existed! There may be a sea route now, but visitors to Tuliyollal are still few and far between.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000770_WUKLAMAT
76.description: And as we don't build seafaring ships, only a handful of Turali ever venture abroad.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000780_ERENVILLE
77.description: Mamool Ja sellswords, mostly. Those willing to play the fool sail with Lominsan merchants to secure employment in Eorzea.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000790_ALPHINAUD
78.description: I suppose that makes us a rare sight in your country.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000800_KRILE
79.description: Rare and currently undocumented. Were there some forms we should fill out, or...?

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000810_WUKLAMAT
80.description: Forms? Did you forget who you're traveling with?

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000820_XBALAALMALESOLDIER
81.description: You are outsiders? Visitors to Tural?

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000840_HOOBIGOMALESOLDIER
83.description: Our nation is soon to hold a rite of succession to choose its next Dawnservant.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000850_HOOBIGOMALESOLDIER
84.description: We will not abide interference from foreign agents seeking to foment trouble. What brings you to Tuliyollal?

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000860_WUKLAMAT
85.description: I can answer that. These fine people are allies in my succession bid.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000870_HOOBIGOMALESOLDIER
86.description: Th-Third Promise! If you vouch for them, then all is well, of course!

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000890_WUKLAMAT
88.description: No need to bow and scrape! That our soldiers are so diligent in their duties fills me with pride.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000900_XBALAALMALESOLDIER
89.description: We'll be continuing our patrol, then!

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000910_ALISAIE
90.description: Well, well. You really are a figure of authority here.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000920_WUKLAMAT
91.description: Are you suggesting I don't look the part!?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000940_WUKLAMAT
93.description: I bid you welcome to Tuliyollal!

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000960_WUKLAMAT
95.description: My companions must sample your heavenly tacos. One for each of us, please.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000970_BRUKEVU
96.description: Right away, Promise─and I'll pack them tight with my choicest fillings! Only the best for you and your friends!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000980_DOPROMALECUSTOMER
97.description: Did you hear the Silverscales are back? Seems their overseas foray ended in disaster. More than half their warband is missing, including their leader.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_000990_XBALAALMALECUSTOMER
98.description: Aye, and now keen to rebuild their broken reputations, the survivors seek the golden city. A fool's errand. How many hopefuls have disappeared in search of that fable? They should count their lucky stars they came home alive at all.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001000_KRILE
99.description: The legend of the golden city is well known here, I take it?

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001010_WUKLAMAT
100.description: It is, but as no one's ever seen it, many question if there is any truth to the tale─like our skeptical Erenville.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001020_KRILE
101.description: I can't imagine the Dawnservant would request a formal survey for a place that doesn't exist...

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001030_WUKLAMAT
102.description: Now to find a spot with a pleasant view to enjoy our crunchy spoils!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001040_BAKOOLJAJA
105.description: (-Two-headed Mamool Ja-)If it isn't the Third “Promise.”

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001060_BAKOOLJAJA
107.description: (-Two-headed Mamool Ja-)I don't know these ones. New salt?

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001070_BAKOOLJAJA
108.description: (-Two-headed Mamool Ja-)Dredged from foreign waters is my guess, Brother.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001080_BAKOOLJAJA
109.description: (-Two-headed Mamool Ja-)Of course, that's it. Wuk Lamat is so afraid of the coming contest that she went crying for special help!

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001090_WUKLAMAT
110.description: Was there something you wanted, Bakool Ja Ja?

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001100_BAKOOLJAJA
111.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)The Third Promise remembers us! Such an honor!

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001110_BAKOOLJAJA
112.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Glory on your name, Brother!

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001120_BAKOOLJAJA
113.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)And on yours, Brother!

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001130_WUKLAMAT
114.description: ...I know my rivals for the throne, nothing more.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001160_BAKOOLJAJA
117.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)We have no ties to their farce of a family!

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001170_BAKOOLJAJA
118.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Unlike this sniveling house cat, we are blessed siblings! The elevated chosen! We alone are fit to succeed Gulool Ja Ja as Dawnservant!

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001180_WUKLAMAT
119.description: All peoples are equal in Tuliyollal! Your heritage gives you no greater claim to the throne!

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001190_BAKOOLJAJA
120.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Shall we test that idea here and now? See if your strength is “equal” to ours?

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001210_KRILE
122.description: None of this has any bearing on the rite of succession, correct? Best not waste your energies on pointless scuffles.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001220_BAKOOLJAJA
123.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)The kitten comes to the house cat's defense!

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001230_BAKOOLJAJA
124.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Pathetic! Since when was our nation overrun by mewling weaklings?

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001270_KRILE
128.description: A two-headed Mamool Ja... I knew of them, but that's the first I've seen in the flesh.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001280_WUKLAMAT
129.description: Some get it into their twin heads that they're destined to follow in my father's footsteps. So they travel to distant lands to hone their battlecraft.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001290_WUKLAMAT
130.description: Those are likely the ones you've heard about.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001310_WUKLAMAT
132.description: No, just Bakool Ja Ja. Even in Tural, his kind are far from common.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001320_WUKLAMAT
133.description: The Mamool Ja people largely belong to one of three clans. The Hoobigo...

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001350_WUKLAMAT
136.description: Every once in a great while, a two-headed offspring is born from a union between the brown-scaled Hoobigo and the blue-scaled Boonewa. The child grows to possess immense strength, both physical and magical.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001370_WUKLAMAT
138.description: Forget them. Let's go and buy more tacos─I can think of nothing better to rid me of this bad taste in my mouth.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001380_ALPHINAUD
139.description: Enjoying your tour of the city, I trust? We've seen our share of notable sights and took a moment to rest.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001390_ALPHINAUD
140.description: As such, we're ready to present ourselves at the palace for the rite of succession. Shall we meet you there?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001400_KRILE
141.description: The palace it is. I'll let Wuk Lamat know.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001410_KRILE
142.description: Destiny calls. Perhaps we can return for more tacos later?

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001430_ALPHINAUD
144.description: Estinien!? When did he get here...?

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001440_ALISAIE
145.description: More to the point, <hex:021A020203>why<hex:021A020103> is he here?

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001460_WUKLAMAT
147.description: Whenever my father spots a promising opponent, he invites them to Sunperch to duel. Pressing duties or no, he can't resist a good fight.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001470_KRILE
148.description: So the one Estinien is crossing blades with...

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001490_GULOOLJAJA
150.description: That will do, spearman. I would receive my darling daughter.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001500_GULOOLJAJA
151.description: Know that you are the strongest I've fought in many a moon, if not longer. It is the privilege of a life long lived to face such a formidable soul!

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001520_ESTINIEN
153.description: If it's formidable you want, then look no further than that man there.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001530_ESTINIEN
154.description: If it's formidable you want, then look no further than that woman there.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001550_ALPHINAUD
156.description: We had no idea you meant to visit Tural...

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001560_ESTINIEN
157.description: I've seen what lies east. This time I chose west.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001570_ALPHINAUD
158.description: And thus did our itinerant dragoon make his travel plans.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001580_ESTINIEN
159.description: You witnessed our bout? If you thought he was fearsome, that was with one head dozing.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001600_WUKLAMAT
161.description: The old man has been feeling his years.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001610_WUKLAMAT
162.description: The uncovered side is the Head of Resolve, and age has only deepened his love for combat...

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001620_WUKLAMAT
163.description: But the Head of Reason, wiser of the two, sleeps more and more these days. As I understand it, the veil helps with the restoration of his magical energies.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001630_GULOOLJAJA
164.description: Enough about me, Lamaty'i. I want to hear of your adventures.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001650_WUKLAMAT
166.description: A term of endearment. It's what my family calls me.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001670_GULOOLJAJA
168.description: When last did we see you in the palace? Greetings, Elene'sh─

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001690_ERENVILLE
170.description: I took the name while abroad, and have since grown accustomed to it...

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001710_GULOOLJAJA
172.description: And these others, I assume, are Lamaty'i's recruited allies.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001720_GULOOLJAJA
173.description: Hah, all tempered steel. Yet as much as I'd enjoy testing their mettle, the hour of the rite is at hand. I will summon the other claimants at once.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001730_ESTINIEN
174.description: Then I shall leave you to it.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001790_GULOOLJAJA
180.description: And lastly, the chosen of Mamook, Bakool Ja Ja.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001800_GULOOLJAJA
181.description: You four will compete in the rite of succession, the outcome of which will decide who takes my place as Dawnservant.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001810_GULOOLJAJA
182.description: I am not the man I once was. My wiser half sleeps the days away, and it is time I yield my position.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001820_GULOOLJAJA
183.description: But mine is a torch that has never been passed. Tuliyollal is young, and so I look to the old ways for inspiration.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001830_GULOOLJAJA
184.description: The rite of succession─the means by which the Autarch of Mamook was chosen.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001840_GULOOLJAJA
185.description: Only the two-headed were deemed fit for this contest, but the Tuliyollal I built is a nation of many peoples. Our leader needn't have two heads, nor be a Mamool Ja at all.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001860_GULOOLJAJA
187.description: So I gave the right of claimant not only to the son I sired, but to my adopted children as well.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001870_GULOOLJAJA
188.description: Yet the opportunity to rule was still not equal. That is why our recent tournament offered a place in the contest as the winning prize.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001890_BAKOOLJAJA
190.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Now you have us to compete against!

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001900_BAKOOLJAJA
191.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Though it seems the one-head was already too afraid to face us in the tournament!

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001910_KOANA
192.description: Our brother was in Xak Tural, leading the Landsguard on a campaign to eradicate a tural vidraal.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001920_KOANA
193.description: Anyone with sense would know he was too busy for games.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001930_GULOOLJAJA
194.description: Now for the part you've been waiting to hear: the nature of the contest itself.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001940_GULOOLJAJA
195.description: To triumph in the rite of succession and thereby claim our nation's throne, you must travel the lands of Yok Tural...

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001980_KOANA
199.description: The golden city is an ancient Turali legend... But after so many failed attempts to find it, the story has become more faerie tale than fact.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_001990_KOANA
200.description: If you would charge us with such a quest, are we then to assume you have proof of the city's existence?

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002000_GULOOLJAJA
201.description: I offer as proof my unbroken word, for I have seen it with my own four eyes.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002010_ERENVILLE
202.description: The city's real? All those years...

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002020_GULOOLJAJA
203.description: This was before the founding of Tuliyollal. I traveled the lands of Tural with my companions, and we ended our journey at the gates to the golden city.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002030_GULOOLJAJA
204.description: I mean to have you do the same. But in order to achieve victory proper, you'll need to break the seal I put in place.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002070_GULOOLJAJA
208.description: You will retrace the path I walked to unite our peoples, step by step. Along the way, seven chosen electors will be waiting to measure your worth.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002080_GULOOLJAJA
209.description: Earn their keystones by performing the feats they ask of you.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002090_GULOOLJAJA
210.description: Once you've fitted each of the seven tablets with a keystone, you'll have the key to unlock the seal on the golden city's gates.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002100_KOANA
211.description: So the contest is in stages, none of which can be skipped by rushing to the ultimate objective.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002120_WUKLAMAT
213.description: Martial tournaments, hunting festivals, and now this... You do so love your contests, Papa.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002140_GULOOLJAJA
215.description: Were I a few years younger I would've joined in myself. Given you a proper challenge!

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002150_GULOOLJAJA
216.description: You may think the rite is tedious, or nonsensical, or both. But I am yielding our nation's throne.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002160_GULOOLJAJA
217.description: Let me have this final indulgence.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002170_BAKOOLJAJA
218.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)A waste of time. Just name Bakool Ja Ja successor and be done with it.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002180_GULOOLJAJA
219.description: The rite of succession begins now! I'll be watching your progress with great interest...

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002190_GULOOLJAJA
220.description: And claimants! Remember to collect your tablets before you leave!

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002200_GULOOLJAJA
221.description: You are one of Lamaty'i's allies. Speak freely.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002210_KRILE
222.description: I am Krile Baldesion, representative of the Students of Baldesion. My name is perhaps familiar to you?

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002230_KRILE
224.description: It would seem you sent this letter to my order some years ago. The ink has since faded and much of the writing is illegible...

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002240_KRILE
225.description: Even so, we managed to determine the essence of it: a request to investigate the golden city, addressed to my grandfather Galuf.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002250_KRILE
226.description: Included with the correspondence was this earring.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002260_KRILE
227.description: A faerie tale and a piece of jewelry were enough to convince my grandfather to sail halfway across the world. So there is surely some greater mystery at work here.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002270_KRILE
228.description: On behalf of the Students, I've come to seek clarification on the matter. Have you any knowledge you might share with me?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002300_GULOOLJAJA
231.description: I have tasked the claimants with finding the golden city. To fulfill your request would afford one of them an unfair advantage in the rite of succession.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002310_GULOOLJAJA
232.description: ...But once the contest is decided, I plan to entrust the entire truth to my successor. If you want to hear it, then you had best help Lamaty'i win.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002330_KRILE
234.description: On my honor as a Student of Baldesion, I will find your golden city!

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002340_KRILE
235.description: Thank you for hearing my petition.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002350_GULOOLJAJA
236.description: How about that. She's grown into a remarkable young woman. You should be proud, Galuf...

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002360_ERENVILLE
237.description: Too late to change your mind now, I suppose, but are you sure you wish to be part of this?

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002370_ERENVILLE
238.description: Our Third Promise is not wont to take no for an answer. Though you may have agreed to help, I worry that you were swept up in her relentless enthusiasm.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002380_ERENVILLE
239.description: Or perhaps you've been lured by the glory of the golden city... Either way, this contest for the throne will place you and yours at the heart of political turmoil.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002390_ERENVILLE
240.description: If you are second-guessing your decision, tell me now. This may be my last chance to help you withdraw.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002400_GRAHATIA
241.description: (-G'raha Tia-)Life is a series of journeys, my friend, and there's no telling what awaits us on the long road.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002410_GRAHATIA
242.description: (-G'raha Tia-)But what's important is to be true to yourself as you walk it.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002420_GRAHATIA
243.description: (-G'raha Tia-)Only then can we hope to be content when we arrive at the end of one─and step forward into another.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
245.description: I want to see where this journey leads.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
246.description: I've made my decision, and I mean to see it through.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002430_ERENVILLE
247.description: So you are committed to your path.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002450_ERENVILLE
249.description: I will speak no more of it, then.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002460_ERENVILLE
250.description: As for my own involvement, I can no longer conduct myself as a mere guide, I think. Not after the Dawnservant's revelation...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002490_XBALAALMALEAUDA
253.description: Such a fearsome mien... Make no mistake─there goes Tuliyollal's mightiest warrior.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002500_TONAWAATAUQMALEAUDA
254.description: First Promise. Our village needs aid! The cold weather stunts our crops, and the children of our village go hungry!

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002510_TONAWAATAUQMALEAUDA
255.description: Once you ascend the throne, I beg of you, grant my people new lands! Please!

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002530_SAREELJA
257.description: Take heart, tiller of the soil. The Resilient Son, blood heir to the Dawnservant, has heard your pleas.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002540_ERENVILLE
258.description: Zoraal Ja. The First Promise and commander of the Landsguard.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002550_ERENVILLE
259.description: Sareel Ja, the palace seer. As he was so careful to remind the crowd, Zoraal Ja is indeed the natural child of Gulool Ja Ja.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002560_ALPHINAUD
260.description: And “Resilient Son”? Is that another title, like the First Promise?

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002570_ERENVILLE
261.description: After a fashion. Common knowledge has it that two-headed Mamool Ja cannot sire children...

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002580_ERENVILLE
262.description: Yet Zoraal Ja was born all the same, with the Head of Resolve's features and the Head of Reason's scales─an extraordinary example of life's unyielding resilience.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002590_ALISAIE
263.description: And a warrior's reticence. He says little, but the way he moves... I know a hardened soldier when I see one.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002600_ERENVILLE
264.description: He's a natural swordsman─a gift he inherited from his father. Some even say that the son has already surpassed the sire.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002610_ERENVILLE
265.description: Should he come to power, the First Promise means to employ that martial prowess in the conquest of foreign lands. For this, he and his supporters have been labeled expansionists.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002620_ERENVILLE
266.description: This puts him in direct opposition to Wuk Lamat, who advocates for the preservation of peace.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002630_ERENVILLE
267.description: You may recall that she spoke of a claimant who “cannot be allowed to rule.” That is Zoraal Ja─the warmonger.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002650_KRILE
269.description: The Echo... It gave me a glimpse into Zoraal Ja's ambitions.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002660_KRILE
270.description: Deep and unknowable, like an abyss, yet at the same time a roaring, unquenchable fire...

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002670_KRILE
271.description: It was a trifle terrifying, to be frank.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002680_PELUPELUMALEAUDA
272.description: Second Promise, you must bring us more marvelous conveniences! More dirigibles and trains and the like! We need you in charge to make trading easier!

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002690_XBALAALMALEAUDB
273.description: The elders, they complain and complain about “abandoning tradition,” but we're not like them, afraid of everything foreign and new!

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002700_PELUPELUMALEAUDA
274.description: You have our wholehearted support! With your ingenuity and knowledge, you're sure to win the contest!

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002710_KOANA
275.description: Forgive me, but the rite of succession is barely begun. I will hear your petitions if and when I am named Dawnservant.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002740_PELUPELUMALEAUDA
278.description: That's our Koana, practical to a fault.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002750_ERENVILLE
279.description: Here we have Koana, the Second Promise, who spent time as a pupil at Sharlayan's own Studium.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002760_ALISAIE
280.description: Now that you mention it, I think I did see him in the halls once or twice. There was nothing to suggest he was Turali, much less from a royal family.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002770_ERENVILLE
281.description: That was by design. He forewent his usual garb and took an Eorzean name to avoid attention.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002780_ALPHINAUD
282.description: So it was Koana who introduced the dirigibles. And the railway, too, given what we just heard...?

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002790_ERENVILLE
283.description: In furtherance of his goal: to enrich Tuliyollal with every bright notion he learned of in Sharlayan. He is the hope of those who prize innovation.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002800_ERENVILLE
284.description: As aloof as he may seem, Koana and Wuk Lamat actually get along rather well. They bicker and banter as only close siblings do.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002820_BAKOOLJAJA
286.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)How gracious of you all to cheer the lesser claimants!

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002830_BAKOOLJAJA
287.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Oh come now, what are you afraid of? I'm no different from your Dawnservant.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002840_BAKOOLJAJA
288.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)That my kind should reign is Mamool Ja tradition─and has been so since before there was a Tuliyollal!

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002850_BAKOOLJAJA
289.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I'll brush aside your feeble contenders, and then you'll see who deserves your fealty!

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002870_BAKOOLJAJA
291.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Well said, Brother!

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002880_BOONEWAFEMALEAUD
292.description: The Mamool Ja have finally found peace in Tuliyollal. A pity those fanatics are intent on keeping that “tradition” alive...

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002890_ERENVILLE
293.description: The chosen of Mamook, Bakool Ja Ja. Winner of the recent martial tournament, and the only claimant not of the Dawn's Promise.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002900_ERENVILLE
294.description: His strength is undeniable, but...you see how he is. A few devoted Mamool Ja are his only supporters.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002910_KRILE
295.description: What would he do with the throne should he win it?

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002920_ERENVILLE
296.description: His policies and so forth? I doubt he's thought much beyond winning the contest itself.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002930_ERENVILLE
297.description: But one thing seems certain: if he does become Dawnservant, he will see the Mamool Ja exalted as the ruling class, and all others forced into subservience.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002940_ALISAIE
298.description: Sounds like another that “cannot be allowed to rule.”

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002950_HANUHANUMALEAUDA
299.description: We wish for one thing, and one thing only, Third Promise: to abide together in harmony, with our neighbors whom we love in this land we share. It is our way─the Turali way.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002960_HOOBIGOFEMALEAUD
300.description: Gulool Ja Ja built for us this peaceful nation, and we beg you to preserve it!

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002970_WUKLAMAT
301.description: You have my word! I won't let your pleas go unanswered!

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_002980_ERENVILLE
302.description: Until Tuliyollal was founded some eighty years ago, this continent was ravaged by war. The eldest among us remember that dark era, and they are Wuk Lamat's most ardent supporters.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003000_WUKLAMAT
304.description: This is Namikka, my childhood nursemaid. She's been like a mother to me my whole life!

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003010_WUKLAMAT
305.description: I told her it wasn't necessary, but she insisted on seeing us off.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003020_NAMIKKA
306.description: I place our precious Third Promise into your care.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003030_SHETONAFEMALEAUD
307.description: Did you know Wuk Lamat was taking part in the rite of succession?

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003040_XBALAALMALEAUDB
308.description: Of the Dawn's Promise, I thought it was only Zoraal Ja and Koana. If she has any accomplishments to her name, I've yet to hear them...

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003050_SHETONAFEMALEAUD
309.description: Compared to the two Mamool Ja, she pales in martial prowess. And then there's Koana, who's far and away the most educated of the bunch. I hate to say it, but it's hardly a competition.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003060_WUKLAMAT
310.description: It's fine. I...understand how much better my brothers are than me.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003070_NAMIKKA
311.description: Better? Wuk Lamat, I have never thought of you as the lesser sibling.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003080_NAMIKKA
312.description: Your brothers may excel in their respective ways, but you boast qualities that both lack. A strength that is yours alone. Having cared for you for so long, I should know.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003100_WUKLAMAT
314.description: Well, we ought to be on our way.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003110_NAMIKKA
315.description: Yes, hurry along. I await word of your victory with bated breath.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003120_ERENVILLE
316.description: Kozama'uka. The land of rainbow terraces.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003130_ERENVILLE
317.description: It commands the gaze of all who visit without fail. The many-colored marvel.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003140_ERENVILLE
318.description: An endless torrent of water cascades over sheer cliffs to shape the wetlands below. To its relentless flow, all life must yield.

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003150_ERENVILLE
319.description: Together with Wuk Lamat, we proceeded along the marshy trail─a road upon which the Dawnservant and his comrades once traveled.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003160_ALISAIE
320.description: Look at those falls... Even from this distance, you can feel the weight of that water!

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003170_WUKLAMAT
321.description: The Isle of Haam was impressive, but as you can see, Tuliyollal does not want for natural wonders.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003180_ERENVILLE
322.description: The ground is swampy, so watch your step. You wouldn't want to fall into a bog.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003190_WUKLAMAT
323.description: I won't! I told you, I've been here before!

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003200_WUKLAMAT
324.description: Come on, Ok'hanu isn't much farther.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003210_WUKLAMAT
325.description: No sign of Zoraal Ja or that oversized lout.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003220_KOANA
326.description: How much easier it would be if Zoraal Ja were to fail here. But that isn't likely to happen...

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003230_ZANUHALI
327.description: Honored guests! I am Zanuhali, elder of the Hanu.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003240_ZANUHALI
328.description: I am also an elector, charged with judging which among you is worthy of ascending the throne.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003250_ZANUHALI
329.description: Without further ado, let us talk of the feat.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003260_BAKOOLJAJA
330.description: (-???-)Not so fast! Surely you couldn't begin without us!

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003270_WUKLAMAT
331.description: Ugh. He made it after all...

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003280_ZANUHALI
332.description: No need to fuss─there is no time limit for this challenge. Now, if you would allow me to proceed...

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003290_ZANUHALI
333.description: It is here, in Ok'hanu, where my people forged a bond with the Dawnservant during our own chapter of the Tuliyollal Saga.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003300_ZANUHALI
334.description: In homage to those events, I have prepared for you the Feat of Reeds.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003310_ALPHINAUD
335.description: Reeds seem to be of great importance to the Hanu. I wonder what this feat entails...

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003320_ZANUHALI
336.description: We use reeds in every part of our lives, be it as food or weaving material.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003330_ZANUHALI
337.description: But look around the nearby paddies, and you will see that this season, our crops are failing.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003340_ZANUHALI
338.description: How fortunate, then, that my appointment to elector coincided with this predicament.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003350_ZANUHALI
339.description: For surely, those who aspire to be Dawnservant would find the matter of an ailing harvest a mere trifle to resolve?

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003360_WUKLAMAT
340.description: Aye, well, it is indeed the duty of a ruler to address the people's woes.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003370_ZANUHALI
341.description: Exactly, exactly! Do well in this, and you will earn my keystone!

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003380_BAKOOLJAJA
342.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Why bother mucking about in the mud...when we can take the stone by force?

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003390_ZANUHALI
343.description: Oh, mercy me! You are a hot-headed fellow, Bakool Ja Ja!

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003400_ZANUHALI
344.description: Some electors may enjoy going toe-to-toe with scrappers like you, but I refuse to entertain your base instincts.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003410_ZANUHALI
345.description: Arrangements have been made. Should you attempt to engage a feat-giver in combat without their consent, word of your immediate disqualification will be sent to the palace. If you're still feeling feisty, then by all means, draw your weapon.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003420_BAKOOLJAJA
346.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Hmph, this contest is presided over by cowards. There's no sport in fighting you.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003430_ZANUHALI
347.description: Then we can return to the business of <hex:021A020203>earning<hex:021A020103> my keystone.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003431_ZANUHALI
348.description: The Feat of Reeds is begun! Claimants, I wish you the best of luck!

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003440_BAKOOLJAJA
349.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)The clever kitty crossed the seas to study foreign novelties─he might know tricks we don't. Tricks we can use.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003450_BAKOOLJAJA
350.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)What of Little Miss Mittens?

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003460_BAKOOLJAJA
351.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Hah, you know the answer to that! Compared to the First and Second Promise, she's a distant Third. Not even in the running!

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003470_BAKOOLJAJA
352.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Then we see eye to eye on this, Brother. Being Bakool Ja Ja so long with me has rubbed off on you!

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003480_BAKOOLJAJA
353.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)These allies of hers, though... They might be a problem.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003490_WUKLAMAT
354.description: Dammit, I'm just as qualified to be here as they are. I'll show them!

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003500_KRILE
355.description: Easy now. There's no time limit, remember? Let's keep calm and think things through.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003510_WUKLAMAT
356.description: Right. You're right. I won't win against that lumbering vidraal by losing my head!

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003520_WUKEVU
357.description: Hm? What do you want with me?

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003560_WUKEVU
361.description: Good, you've brought your manners with you.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003570_WUKEVU
362.description: When in Ok'hanu, do as the Hanu do. For a country as diverse as ours, the preservation of harmony demands that we respect the cultures of all peoples who call it home.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003580_WUKLAMAT
363.description: Well...that explains your familiarity with Hanu customs.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003590_WUKLAMAT
364.description: And you speak truth, of course. To live together means to learn about each other.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003600_WUKEVU
365.description: Ah, I appreciate an open mind.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003610_WUKEVU
366.description: In fact, I get the sense we've met before...

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003630_WUKEVU
368.description: Oh, what an unexpected honor for old Wuk Evu! Here I am prattling on about manners, and I've gone and insulted the Third Promise herself! There is no excuse for this betrayal of etiquette.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003640_WUKEVU
369.description: Please, take up your axe and claim my impudent head...

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003650_WUKLAMAT
370.description: I will not! Keep your head!

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003660_WUKLAMAT
371.description: I hate formalities anyway, so forget about it, all right?

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003670_WUKEVU
372.description: All right, then. Consider it forgotten.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003690_WUKLAMAT
374.description: We're actually here about the Ihih'hana float. It's in bad shape, and we need you to craft new carrying poles and a new eye. I'm told you work with uyuipo wood and a certain kind of stone...er, abokixa?

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003700_WUKEVU
375.description: That I do. But while I would like nothing more than to offer my services, I just used the last I had of both those materials.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003710_WUKEVU
376.description: My lumber in particular went to fixing homes damaged by the recent storm. I'll need ten days or so to restock.

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003720_WUKLAMAT
377.description: We can't wait that long. If you tell me where to go, I'll gather them myself.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003730_WUKEVU
378.description: What? Send the Third Promise out on an errand like some common lackey? That's utterly unconscionable! A gross violation of social protocol!

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003740_WUKLAMAT
379.description: I told you not to worry about such things!

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003750_WUKEVU
380.description: All right, then. I shan't worry a whit.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003760_WUKEVU
381.description: What's with your Hanu friend there?

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003770_LINUHANU
382.description: I am festival leader this season, and have come along to oversee the float's repair.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003780_LINUHANU
383.description: As strange as it may sound, Wuk Lamat and her friends believe the float is an arcane focus meant to encourage the growth of our struggling reeds.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003790_WUKEVU
384.description: Too many Hanu have forgotten, it seems, but that is indeed the true purpose of the Lifting of Wings. Your education is impressive, Third Promise.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003810_WUKEVU
386.description: Allow me to show you where to procure uyuipo.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003820_WUKEVU
387.description: We can leave the abokixa to your friends, I presume? Take yourself to Cave Kikitola or thereabouts, and you should find the stones you need.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003830_LINUHANU
388.description: I've been there once or twice. I can guide you.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003840_KRILE
389.description: That should save us some time.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003860_DOPROBAKOOLJAJAMINIONS
391.description: Chosen one. One of your rivals is making progress...

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003870_BAKOOLJAJA
392.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Ihih'hana, you say...

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003880_BAKOOLJAJA
393.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Should our first choice fail to deliver, it might be wise to let this play out...

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003900_BAKOOLJAJA
395.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)The Third-rate Promise is making herself useful after all.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003920_BAKOOLJAJA
397.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Not sure we heard you right, old man. Why don't you say that again.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003930_WUKEVU
398.description: As many times as you like. The Third Promise tasked me with repairing this float, and I'll not relinquish it to an uncultured brute like you.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003940_WUKEVU
399.description: Much less one that can't even manage a simple greeting.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003950_BAKOOLJAJA
400.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)We wanted to handle this in a civilized way, but we're more than willing to kill you.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003960_ERENVILLE
401.description: We have a two-headed problem. Yes, please hurry.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_003980_LINUHANU
403.description: S-S-Stand back, Wuk Evu! I will protect the float!

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004000_BAKOOLJAJA
405.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Are you trying to be brave, little bird?

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004010_LINUHANU
406.description: I could never have repaired the float alone─not properly. But thanks to Wuk Lamat and her friends, we can hold Ihih'hana again!

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004020_LINUHANU
407.description: This is a priceless treasure...and as festival leader, I would die to protect it!

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004030_BAKOOLJAJA
408.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Very well, if that's what you want.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004080_WUKLAMAT
413.description: I put everything into that blow...

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004090_BAKOOLJAJA
414.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Good. The better for you to understand the gulf between us.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004100_BAKOOLJAJA
415.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)But you need more lessons! We'll carve them into your mangy hide until you cry and beg forgiveness!

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004110_ALISAIE
416.description: Your brilliant plan was to steal the float and take the credit? The so-called “blessed siblings” are nothing but cheats!

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004120_BAKOOLJAJA
417.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Your scorn is sweet music. Come, weaklings─we'll crush you each in turn...or all together, if you like!

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004130_DOPROBAKOOLJAJAMINIONS
418.description: Calm yourself, chosen one! If you fight in earnest, this will end in a massacre!

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004140_DOPROBAKOOLJAJAMINIONS
419.description: What's more, we have word that our “other” prospect is on the verge of success!

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004150_BAKOOLJAJA
420.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Then it would be foolish to expend effort swatting gnats.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004160_BAKOOLJAJA
421.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Lucky for you, eh?

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004170_WUKEVU
422.description: Two-heads. I see Mamook still clings to that loathsome hope...

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004180_LINUHANU
423.description: Talk to us, Third Promise! You're not dying, are you!?

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004190_WUKLAMAT
424.description: Hah! It'll take more than that to kill me!

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004200_WUKLAMAT
425.description: So...are we having this festival or not?

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004230_WUKEVU
428.description: Patience. Once Ihih'hana gets underway, no Hanu will be able to resist joining in.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004240_LINUHANU
429.description: Just so! Wuk Evu knows well the heart of the Hanu!

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004250_LINUHANU
430.description: Have faith, Third Promise, and climb aboard the float! It is time for the Lifting of Wings!

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004270_WUKEVU
432.description: Ihih'hana is a prayer for bountiful harvest, but this is not its only meaning.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004280_WUKEVU
433.description: It is also an exchange of pledges between rider and bearers─a commitment to a long and fruitful friendship.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004290_LINUHANU
434.description: Listen well, friends! The personage we bear today is Wuk Lamat, the savior of our beloved festival!

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004300_LINUHANU
435.description: Let your shoulders burn or your feathers fall out, but do not even think of dropping her!

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004360_WUKLAMAT
441.description: I could get used to this.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004370_LINUHANU
442.description: Will empty bellies stop you from joining in the fun? Come and help us carry the float!

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004380_ZANUHALI
443.description: Well, well, well. To see the day the Dawn's Promise would ride our boat again.

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004390_ZANUHALI
444.description: We've not had the honor since you were here, Gulool Ja Ja.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004400_LINUHANU
445.description: Right, we've enough bearers now! Onwards to Kozanuakiy!

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004410_WUKEVU
446.description: Watch well, for you are about to bear witness to the true glory of Ihih'hana!

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004420_WUKEVU
447.description: The float draws upon our life force, concentrating and amplifying the energy...

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004430_WUKEVU
448.description: Kixaihih then receives that energy and expels it in a great burst, where it showers down upon the land to replenish its vital currents!

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004460_LINUHANU
451.description: The float really was helping the reeds...

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004470_WUKLAMAT
452.description: That was...amazing. To think that such a thing was even possible!

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004480_WUKLAMAT
453.description: Some of them still look a bit sickly...

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004490_ALPHINAUD
454.description: I imagine even the harvest magic has its limits. If the Hanu continue their festival tradition year after year, though, the entire field should eventually recover.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004500_KRILE
455.description: Where does that leave us with the feat, then...?

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004510_ZANUHALI
456.description: (-???-)You've got nothing to fear on that account.

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004520_ZANUHALI
457.description: Our situation could never have resolved itself. The revival of even a single reed would have served to demonstrate your commitment to the task.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004530_ZANUHALI
458.description: That you recognized the nature of the float and found a near-perfect solution in Ihih'hana proves your dedication!

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004540_ZANUHALI
459.description: What's more, I don't think I've seen the festival produce such impressive results since I was a mere chirper.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004550_ZANUHALI
460.description: We have been lax in maintaining the float, diluting its magic and reducing Ihih'hana to hollow theater.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004551_ZANUHALI
461.description: But today's events remind us of the power in tradition.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004570_KOANA
463.description: I was delayed by an unpleasant encounter, but it seems I arrived at a good time.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004590_WUKLAMAT
465.description: What!? You just pour in some mystery liquid, and problem solved!?

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004600_ALPHINAUD
466.description: Stagnant aether was to blame for the reeds' poor condition. I assume that was an alchemical concoction which enhances aetherial conductivity.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004610_ALPHINAUD
467.description: It utilized the flowing water as an aetherial current, thereby promoting the transfer of life energies.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004620_KOANA
468.description: A method I could not have devised without the education I received at the Studium and the cooperation of my Archon allies.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004640_KOANA
470.description: You see, Lamaty'i? This is why we need to embrace foreign knowledge and technology.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004650_KOANA
471.description: Employed appropriately, they make light work of what would otherwise be arduous labor. There's no need to lug around heavy floats!

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004660_WUKLAMAT
472.description: Well, you always were the clever one, Brother.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004670_KRILE
473.description: Your approach was no less effective, Wuk Lamat. It achieved the same result.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004680_LINUHANU
474.description: Indeed it did. And you enjoyed the festival, yes?

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004690_WUKLAMAT
475.description: I did! It was so much fun!

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004700_WUKLAMAT
476.description: Having visited your village before, I thought I knew everything about it.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004710_WUKLAMAT
477.description: As it turns out, I knew very little. About the reeds, about Ihih'hana...

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004720_WUKLAMAT
478.description: With all I've learned this time, I feel as though I've really come to know the Hanu...

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004730_WUKLAMAT
479.description: And I like you even more now than I did before!

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004740_LINUHANU
480.description: The feeling is mutual. And it's not just you who had a lot to learn, either─I'll never look at our float the same way again!

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004750_ZANUHALI
481.description: The two of you have exceeded expectations. Come forth and claim your stones.

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004770_WUKLAMAT
483.description: So this is what they look like...

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004780_ALISAIE
484.description: Go on, set it in the tablet!

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004790_WUKLAMAT
485.description: A perfect fit! That leaves six more.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004810_WUKLAMAT
487.description: Not even a moment of celebration... That's Koana for you.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004820_LINUHANU
488.description: Third Promise, you must join us for Ihih'hana next season.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004840_WUKLAMAT
490.description: Right, it's back to Tuliyollal for now.

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004850_WUKLAMAT
491.description: Thank you for having us. I look forward to seeing you all again!

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004870_DOPROBAKOOLJAJAMINIONS
493.description: The concoction was brewed by Koana himself. It's a test vial, but it should contain the same reagents.

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004880_BAKOOLJAJA
494.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Good work. We'll use whatever we must to win. For win we must.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004890_ERENVILLE
495.description: Turali poets of yore sang of a mountain that would stand tall even should all other lands sink beneath the sea.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004900_ERENVILLE
496.description: Indomitable and eternal, it arises from Urqopacha─the hundred peaks of time.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004910_ERENVILLE
497.description: Of all the beasts which crawl and fly, only the legendary Valigarmanda could hope to disturb the summit's serene majesty.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004920_ERENVILLE
498.description: Yet with that flying calamity imprisoned by the Dawnservant, what great feat remains for those who would claim the throne?

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004930_WUKLAMAT
499.description: So this is Urqopacha... I've never actually been here before.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004940_KRILE
500.description: The air is so crisp and clear.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004960_ALPHINAUD
502.description: That one massive peak in particular has quite the presence. It puts me in mind of Sohm Al.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_004970_ERENVILLE
503.description: That is Worqor Zormor, the tallest mountain in Yok Tural. Its sheer height makes it an imposing climb, but there are other reasons the ambitious keep their distance...

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005000_BOLNOQ
506.description: (-???-)Excuse me, but...you're Wuk Lamat, are you not? I-I hadn't thought to encounter one of the Dawn's Promise here of all places...

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005010_BOLNOQ
507.description: Ah, but I should introduce myself. I am Bol Noq', a weaver by trade.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005020_WUKLAMAT
508.description: Well met, Bol Noq'. We're on our way to Wachunpelo.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005030_BOLNOQ
509.description: Truly? I've just come from there, as it happens.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005040_BOLNOQ
510.description: I'd asked the Pelupelu who sell me their wool to give me a tour of their alpaca ranch.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005050_BOLNOQ
511.description: The head rancher and I shared a bottle of mezcal while he explained the finer points of wool production.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005060_ALISAIE
512.description: Mezcal? Is that a local beverage?

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005070_ERENVILLE
513.description: It's an Urqopacha specialty. A spirit made from distilled agave heart juice.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005080_BOLNOQ
514.description: Yes, and it must have done wonders for my mood, for I tripled my usual order of alpaca wool. They did offer me a discount, though, so it wasn't a bad deal in the end.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005090_BOLNOQ
515.description: Ah, but listen to me boring you with my tedious stories. I-I will leave you before you are lulled to sleep. Good-bye, and safe travels.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005100_BOLNOQ
516.description: Oh, silly me. I almost forgot to say the thing I actually wanted to say.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005110_BOLNOQ
517.description: Peace for Tural─I agree with your vision, Third Promise. You have my support in your bid for the throne.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005120_ALPHINAUD
518.description: I gather from his tale we would be foolish to underestimate Pelupelu merchants...

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005130_ERENVILLE
519.description: Yes, they do more than run the markets in Tuliyollal. Pelupelu peddlers can be found everywhere in Tural, traveling from place to place on their sturdy alpacas.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005140_ERENVILLE
520.description: They are effusive and engaging speakers, and many's the customer who's been talked into spending more than they bargained for.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005150_WUKLAMAT
521.description: They won't find this customer so easily charmed!

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005160_ERENVILLE
522.description: Wachunpelo's down the path off the main road! Don't get lost!

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005180_TOBLI
524.description: Deducing the Dawnservant's elector was the first step of the feat. Too simple a task for this aspiring ruler, eh?

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005210_ZORAALJA
527.description: I am told the head ledger, Tobli, is to be found here.

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005220_MABLU
528.description: You have to guess which one of us is Tobli! That's part of the test!

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005240_TOBLI
530.description: Without even asking a single question... Very impressive indeed.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005250_TOBLI
531.description: With that amusing prologue out of the way, we can proceed to the actual challenge.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005260_TOBLI
532.description: Per the Dawnservant's instructions, I was free to devise any manner of feat. I considered a number of possibilities─in the tens column─but I think I have a good one.

533.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005270_TOBLI
533.description: You must go forth...and capture for me an alpaca.

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005280_WUKLAMAT
534.description: While I've not had the best experiences with alpacas, aren't they generally docile creatures? That doesn't sound like much of a challenge.

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005300_TOBLI
537.description: This is a special kind of alpaca. Would you please approach the animal, Third Promise?

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005310_WUKLAMAT
538.description: Who, me? Well, it should stay calm if I stay calm, right? That's what Erenville said...

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005330_WUKLAMAT
540.description: The little monster spat on me!

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005360_TOBLI
543.description: Alpacas are paradoxical creatures, being both extremely curious and extremely cowardly.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005370_TOBLI
544.description: Press your luck when they're frightened, and you'll get a face full of spit...as you've all just witnessed.

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005380_TOBLI
545.description: Has an awful stench, their expectoration. The globs contain half-digested food, you see, making it an effective deterrent against perceived threats.

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005390_MABLU
546.description: Wild valley breeds, like this one, are especially timid─and can therefore be quick to lash out.

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005410_TOBLI
548.description: Indeed. We take the rugged wild alpacas and breed them with our gentle domesticated stock. This produces the strong-but-biddable pack animals prized by our traveling merchants.

550.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005430_WUKLAMAT
550.description: That's all well and good. But did I need to bathe in alpaca spit for you to make your point...?

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005440_ZORAALJA
551.description: So the task is to catch a wild alpaca?

552.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005450_TOBLI
552.description: That is correct, but be warned that it is a feat easier said than done. I suggest you prepare well before you enter the valley where the creatures dwell.

553.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005460_TOBLI
553.description: And by “you,” I mean the claimants only. Allies are not permitted to assist with the catching.

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005470_TOBLI
554.description: The alpacas will help me judge which of you is worthy of receiving a keystone.

555.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005480_WUKLAMAT
555.description: So I'm to chase down a fluffy, spitting demon...and that somehow proves I'm fit to rule.

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005490_TOBLI
557.description: As I said, the Dawnservant granted me the freedom to decide my challenge.

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005500_TOBLI
558.description: And when you reach the end of the rite, I daresay you will understand why I chose what I chose.

559.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005510_ZORAALJA
559.description: Very well. This won't take long.

561.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005530_TOBLI
561.description: Didn't I warn you this was easier said than done!? There are preparations to be made! Factors to consider!

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005540_ZORAALJA
562.description: A beast is a beast. All yield to strength.

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005550_WUKLAMAT
563.description: So far, this experience has done absolutely nothing to improve my opinion of alpacas.

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005560_WUKLAMAT
564.description: But that doesn't mean I can't do this! Revolting spit aside, they're just another animal...

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005570_ALPHINAUD
565.description: Are you all right, Wuk Lamat? We thought we heard you scream...

566.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005580_WUKLAMAT
566.description: The Third Promise does not scream! It was more of a...startled yelp.

572.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005640_WUKLAMAT
572.description: Truth be told, I'm still not sure about alpacas. I'd rather not go near one if I can help it.

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005650_WUKLAMAT
573.description: But if I'm to rule this nation, then I'll need to learn how to live with them. Tural is their home, too.

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005670_ALPHINAUD
575.description: So, shall we head back to the ranch, or...

577.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005690_KRILE
577.description: As will I. Wuk Lamat is alone in this. The least we can do is stand watch and await her return.

578.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005700_ERENVILLE
578.description: It may be a while yet. Help me pitch the tent.

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005710_ALISAIE
579.description: Trust a gleaner to come prepared for anything.

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005730_ALPHINAUD
581.description: Someone whose job it is to travel the world and procure uncommon things for their employers. Erenville specializes in finding animals, I believe.

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005740_MABLU
582.description: But aren't you a Shetona, from Xak Tural? Why did you cross the salt?

583.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005750_ERENVILLE
583.description: When I was much younger, the thought of leaving Tural never even occurred to me.

584.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005760_ERENVILLE
584.description: But then, some years ago, my mentor tasked me with a difficult hunt.

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005770_ERENVILLE
585.description: Something I could never find, she said, so long as I clung to the familiar. She suggested that I leave home─leave Tural─and join the gleaners of Sharlayan.

586.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005780_ERENVILLE
586.description: As one of their number, I could experience the world. Immerse myself in myriad cultures and customs. See the many faces of nature. And once I had learned what is truly important, I would find that which I seek.

587.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005790_ERENVILLE
587.description: My younger self took those words to heart, and off I went to become a gleaner.

588.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005800_MABLU
588.description: Her words alone moved you to leave behind everything you'd ever known? You must have great respect for your mentor.

589.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005810_ERENVILLE
589.description: As it happens, gleaner work was much to my liking, and I all but forgot why I had pursued it in the first place...

590.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005820_ERENVILLE
590.description: Yet events conspired to put me back on the trail I'd abandoned.

591.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005830_KRILE
591.description: Wait... Are you saying you were tasked with finding the city of gold?

592.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005840_ERENVILLE
592.description: I was. And though my hunt is now entangled with the rite of succession, I mean to see it through.

593.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005850_KRILE
593.description: Well then...I understand completely! We all have our reasons for seeking the golden city...

594.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005860_KRILE
594.description: Which is all the more reason for us to work together!

597.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005890_MABLU
597.description: She should've been back by now! What if something's happened to her? We need to tell Tobli and arrange a search party!

600.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005920_ALPHINAUD
600.description: You're utterly spent, and small wonder.

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005940_ERENVILLE
602.description: The ranch isn't going anywhere. Take a rest in the tent.

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005950_WUKLAMAT
603.description: I think I will. Thank you all for believing in me.

604.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005960_WUKLAMAT
604.description: This is as far as we can go on foot, it seems. We'll have to head back and see about fixing the boat...

606.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005980_ALISAIE
606.description: I've been meaning to ask, but...how <hex:021A020203>does<hex:021A020103> one become the adopted child of the Dawnservant?

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_005990_WUKLAMAT
607.description: I was but a ball of fuzz at the time, so I don't remember much. My earliest memories are of life in the palace.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006000_WUKLAMAT
608.description: All I know is that I was born in Iq Br'aax, a village in Yak T'el. But I've never bothered to return there.

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006010_WUKLAMAT
609.description: As far as I'm concerned, Gulool Ja Ja is my only parent.

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006020_KRILE
610.description: I quite understand. I have no memories of my birth parents either.

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006030_KRILE
611.description: For a while, I wanted to learn who they were, but over time that curiosity waned. Galuf was my dear grandfather, and he was all I needed.

612.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006040_WUKLAMAT
612.description: So our situations were quite similar.

613.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006050_WUKLAMAT
613.description: Even though Papa already had a trueborn son, he raised me and Koana with no less love.

614.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006060_WUKLAMAT
614.description: One time, I'd wandered off alone into the forest and gotten lost. Before I became a meal for some beast, Papa dropped everything and came to my rescue.

615.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006070_WUKLAMAT
615.description: I was scared and sobbing and ready for a scolding, but the Head of Resolve praised me for surviving the ordeal.

616.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006080_WUKLAMAT
616.description: I did get my lecture from the Head of Reason, though! He went on and on about the dangers of the jungle, and all the horrible ways I could've died...

617.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006090_WUKLAMAT
617.description: Growing up, Papa was kind and patient, but a tyrant when it came to training. Now, of course, I realize he was preparing me for my duties as a Promise.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006100_WUKLAMAT
618.description: For all the good it did...

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006110_WUKLAMAT
619.description: There's so much I failed to learn about my own country. Whether it's alpacas or Ihih'hana, I hardly know anything!

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006120_WUKLAMAT
620.description: I've lived such a sheltered life, yet convinced myself I understood Tural and its people!

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006130_WUKLAMAT
621.description: I don't have Koana's education or Zoraal Ja's strength. I'm all bluff and bravado, not fit to bear my title...

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
623.description: You can't measure your worth by the success of others.

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
624.description: Why do you want the throne?

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006140_WUKLAMAT
625.description: Don't compare myself to my siblings, you mean?

626.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006150_WUKLAMAT
626.description: Why? Because my father built a nation where everyone can live in peace, and I want to keep it that way.

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006160_WUKLAMAT
627.description: I... I think I see what you're saying.

628.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006170_WUKLAMAT
628.description: My reasons for joining the contest have nothing to do with my brothers.

629.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006180_WUKLAMAT
629.description: It's always been about the Turali, and what I can do for them!

630.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006190_KRILE
630.description: You said it yourself, how important it is to properly “know” something...

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006200_KRILE
631.description: To hear the voices of others, empathize with how they feel, and think how best to serve... In so doing, you'll come ever closer to being the person you wish to be.

632.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006210_WUKLAMAT
632.description: I'm sorry, everyone. I've been a fool.

633.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006220_WUKLAMAT
633.description: From this moment on, I'll stop trying to be the Promise I'm not. I won't feign strength to hide my weaknesses!

634.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006230_WUKLAMAT
634.description: Step by step, I'll learn all there is to know and love about Tuliyollal and my fellow Turali.

635.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006240_WUKLAMAT
635.description: It might not be the smoothest path, but it'll be a path of my own making!

636.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006250_WUKLAMAT
636.description: I will find the city of gold, for all of us! Along with the answers you seek about your grandfather, Krile. I swear.

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006260_KRILE
637.description: I appreciate it, Wuk Lamat. But you needn't take on that burden as well.

638.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006270_KRILE
638.description: Galuf Baldesion dedicated his life to protecting people from all manner of threats.

639.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006280_KRILE
639.description: As his granddaughter, I wouldn't wish to endanger others for the sake of a personal investigation.

640.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006290_KRILE
640.description: So let's just concentrate on winning the contest. We have a shared goal, and if at all possible, I'd rather we enjoy the journey!

641.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006300_ALPHINAUD
641.description: Hear, hear. We are companions on the same road, bound for the same destination. With our combined talents, nothing will stop us from reaching the golden city!

642.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006310_WUKLAMAT
642.description: Thank you─thank you all. I am proud to call you my friends!

643.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006320_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
643.description: Meanwhile, in the Second Promise's camp...

644.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006330_WUKLAMAT
644.description: (-Wuk Lamat-)Thank you─thank you all. I am proud to call you my friends!

645.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006340_THANCRED
645.description: They seem to be enjoying themselves. Are you sure you don't want to go and say a word to your sister?

646.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006350_KOANA
646.description: Nay, there is no need for that.

647.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006360_KOANA
647.description: But what of you two? Wuk Lamat's allies are your comrades. It must feel strange to be rivals.

648.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006370_THANCRED
648.description: Helping you has made us rivals, aye, but we're not about to break into fisticuffs over it.

649.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006380_THANCRED
649.description: Unless of course it is a matter of winning or losing the contest. Then I'll have no qualms about putting Alisaie on her rear.

650.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006390_URIANGER
650.description: Despite our long history, never have I been given the chance to test myself against our companions. The thought stirreth within me a most unexpected sense of competition.

652.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006410_KOANA
652.description: Lamaty'i has surrounded herself with distinguished figures indeed. One of the Studium's finest graduates. The head of the Students of Baldesion...

653.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006420_KOANA
653.description: And then there's Eorzea's vaunted champion. If <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>'s half the hero you say, then the odds are stacked against us.

654.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006430_KOANA
654.description: Not that I've any intention of bowing out.

655.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006440_KOANA
655.description: Our time in Urqopacha only served to strengthen my resolve. We saw how a single storm cut off the alpaca routes and threw my peoples' lives into disarray.

656.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006450_KOANA
656.description: Such uncertainties are why I advocate for the adoption of Sharlayan innovations, that Tuliyollal might know greater stability and prosperity.

657.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006460_KOANA
657.description: Our nation can change for the better...and I will be the man to change it.

659.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006480_THANCRED
659.description: I imagine your experiences on this journey─all the things you'll hear, and feel, and think─will help you refine that approach.

660.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006490_THANCRED
660.description: But to return to the subject of the rite, I'm a touch concerned by the condition for victory.

661.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006500_THANCRED
661.description: The claimant who breaks the seal becomes Dawnservant─not the one who performed the seven feats first.

662.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006510_URIANGER
662.description: The would-be victor need only possess the seven keystones...

663.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006520_KOANA
663.description: That is correct. As the contest wears on, we must brace ourselves for greater conflict.

666.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006550_SAREELJA
