666.description: The Second and Third Promise may have recruited competent lackeys, but none compare to you.

667.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006560_SAREELJA
667.description: How can they hope to compete with the Resilient Son, the only child ever sired by a two-head!

668.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006570_SAREELJA
668.description: Only the ignorant or foolish could fail to see that you were born to be Dawnservant!

670.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006590_SAREELJA
670.description: Ah, I neglected to mention... When I first heard the rumors that the contest involved the golden city, I spoke in confidence with Gulool Ja Ja's inner circle.

671.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006600_SAREELJA
671.description: They all agreed on one thing...

672.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006610_SAREELJA
672.description: Whoever reaches the city of gold will attain a power so great it can dictate the course of history.

673.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006620_SAREELJA
673.description: If this power truly exists, then I humbly beg a fair share of it.

674.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006630_SAREELJA
674.description: Time is passing, and I would put my plans in motion without delay. The useless tool is cast aside, after all.

675.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006640_SAREELJA
675.description: And just so there is no misunderstanding... You consent to this course no matter who is made to suffer?

676.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006650_ZORAALJA
676.description: In battle, everyone bleeds. The Dawn's Promise is no exception.

677.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006660_ZORAALJA
677.description: What better lesson to teach our people the folly of war.

679.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006680_BAKOOLJAJA
679.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I was hoping for a good scrap, but this bloated sack of bile was no challenge at all.

680.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006690_BAKOOLJAJA
680.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Hmmm... I wonder if the house cat is dead yet...

681.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006700_BAKOOLJAJA
681.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Be a shame to lose a plaything, but we'd still have two more. Heh heh.

682.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006710_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSA
682.description: If I may ask, chosen one, what are your plans for Tuliyollal after you take the throne?

683.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006720_BAKOOLJAJA
683.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Plans? What makes you think we care about all that?

684.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006730_BAKOOLJAJA
684.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)We care only about the contest, and proving our superiority.

685.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006740_BAKOOLJAJA
685.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)That would surely please Mother and Father.

686.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006750_BAKOOLJAJA
686.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)Yes, and when we become Dawnservant, we'll drive out the weakling masses and invite our kin to live in the city.

687.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006760_BAKOOLJAJA
687.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Aha, a fine idea! Our family deserves better than that rotten jungle!

688.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006770_BAKOOLJAJA
688.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)Back to it, then! We must catch up to that one-headed pretender and remind him of the natural order!

690.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006790_BAKOOLJAJA
690.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)I thought we were missing someone. Where have you been?

691.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006800_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSB
691.description: I feared I was done for when I fell from the boat, yet somehow I made it...

692.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006810_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSB
692.description: Oh, my arms...I can barely lift them. I-If I could just rest a moment...

693.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006820_BAKOOLJAJA
693.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mystic-)You expect <hex:021A020203>us<hex:021A020103> to wait for <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>? Those who can't keep up will be left behind.

694.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006830_BAKOOLJAJA
694.description: (-Bakool Ja Ja the Mighty-)My brother has spoken. March, or be fodder for the beasts.

695.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006840_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSB
695.description: ...But I followed the teachings! Everything I've done─everything I've sacrificed─all has been for the blessed siblings!

696.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07000_006850_HOOBIGOBAKOOLJAJAMINIONSB
696.description: Wait! Don't leave me behind... I'm begging you!
